create_ltx2_vocoder: create an LTX2 vocoder model to convert mel spectrograms back to audio waveforms
create_ltx2_vocoder_with_bwe: create an LTX2 vocoder with bandwidth extension to upsample audio to a higher sampling rate
create_anti_alias_activation: create an anti-aliasing activation module that upsamples, applies activation, and downsamples a 1D signal
create_snake_beta_activation: create a SnakeBeta activation function that helps with learning periodic patterns
create_causal_stft: create a causal short-time Fourier transform module to compute magnitude and phase from a waveform
